import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int b = in.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = in.nextInt();
        }
        int[] odd = new int[n + 1];
        int[] even = new int[n + 1];
        odd[0] = 0;
        even[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (a[i - 1] % 2 == 1) {
                odd[i] = odd[i - 1] + 1;
                even[i] = even[i - 1];
            } else {
                odd[i] = odd[i - 1];
                even[i] = even[i - 1] + 1;
            }
        }
        int prev = 0;
        PriorityQueue<Integer> cost = new PriorityQueue<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n - 1; i++) {
            int oc = odd[i] - odd[prev];
            int ec = even[i] - even[prev];
            if (oc == ec) {
                cost.add(Math.abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]));
                prev = i;
            }
        }
        int sum = 0;
        int count = 0;
        while (!cost.isEmpty() && sum <= b) {
            sum += cost.peek();
            cost.poll();
            count++;
        }
        if (count == 0) {
            System.out.println("0");
        } else {
            if (cost.isEmpty() && sum <= b) {
                System.out.println(count);
            } else {
                System.out.println(count - 1);
            }
        }
    }
}

            c = read();

            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));

            res.appendCodePoint(c);
